note: This hub repo is PRIVATE maintainer infrastructure (index + template + tools). It absorbed the former devin-ci and devin-repo-template repos. Public user-facing repos are listed below (15 projects). Consolidation 2026-09-30: devin-dashboard->devin-metrics, devin-learning->devin-memory, devin-subagent-orchestrator->devin-orchestrator. 2026-10-01: personal-agent-system added as kind=system (private runtime repo, lives outside devin-ecosystem/ via local_dir). Non-ecosystem repos (PetSaas, qwenpaw-sync, ai-survival-trader-refactored, pokeemerald-hackrom) are intentionally NOT listed. CI is INLINE per repo; see the CI status section in README.md.

ci.previous_architecture: reusable workflows in the private devin-ci/devin-powerups hub
ci.reason: Reusable workflows living in a private repo are not reliably accessible from public repos, so each project ships a self-contained ci.yml.
ci.shape: test job (pytest for Python repos, node --test for devin-bridge) on windows-latest + ubuntu-latest, plus a secrets-scan job over the repository tree excluding .git, fixtures/ and node_modules/; test source is scanned.

known_issues: Package publishing (PyPI/npm) and follow-on M2/M3 integrations remain open.
